To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the bag net fisher of Maharashtra coast, in general, comply with most of the provisions of Article 7 of CCRF.

the overall compliance level with Article 7 (management of fishery resources) of the FAO CCRF by stakeholders involved in bag net fishery in Maharashtra, India is 67.52%, with the lowest compliance being observed with respect to clause 7.1.3 on conservation and protection of the environment, 7.2.1 on management objectives and 7.4.2 on management of fishing capacity.
the bag net fishers of Maharashtra coast are not aware of the CCRF.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a case study of the compliance of a traditional fishery in India to the Code.
a specific fishery, the bag net fish, and its management in the State of Maharashtra.
the development and implementation of a management plan for the bag net fishers and the fishery resources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present study has provided an opportunity to identify areas of improvement in the fishery management system of Maharashtra and to make recommendations for improving the fishery management practices in the State.
the bag net fishers of Maharashtra are not yet fully compliant with the CCRF.
the bag net fisher of Maharashtra coast has a fair level of compliance with the relevant clauses in Article 7 of CCRF.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Code could be used as an effective tool for the development of fisheries policies and for ensuring sustainable management of fisheries resources.

the present study could help in identifying the gaps in the management of the fish resources in the State of Maharashtra and could be taken as reference for other coastal states to initiate responsible management of their fisheries.

the Code of Conduct is an excellent tool for the responsible management of fisheries and the present study has demonstrated the utility of the Code for the responsible management and conservation of the bag net fisheries in the study area.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Code can be a valuable tool to assess the status of fishery management and suggest measures to improve the management.
a comprehensive evaluation of the compliance of fishery with the Code of Conduct is essential to ensure responsible management of the fishery.
, the CCRF can serve as a useful reference document for responsible management of the small-scale fisheries in India.
